stayType: Large seafront hotel on Narrowcliff, Newquay
accommodation: About 105 rooms in six types: standard doubles and twins (some sea view), single rooms and a triple suite
suitableFor: Groups and budget-minded visitors wanting a central Newquay base; stag and hen parties are refused
beachAccess: Tolcarne Beach is a couple of minutes' walk and Great Western Beach about 250-300 m; Towan Beach is roughly 10 minutes on foot
confirmedFeatures: 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, terrace, free Wi-Fi in public areas only, no lift, no breakfast served
overview: The Beresford is a large three-star hotel on Narrowcliff in Newquay, close to Tolcarne and Great Western beaches. Rooms range from singles to a triple suite, with some sea-view doubles and twins. Breakfast is not served and there is no lift.
surfTripFit: A central, no-frills base within walking distance of Tolcarne and Great Western; no board storage or drying facilities are mentioned.
gaps: No official website found; details cross-referenced from two booking sites that disagree on parking and the pet fee. Room count from one source. Check directly before promoting.
